name: Complex-resistivity monitoring of Arctic-soil freeze–thaw
plain_name: Track frozen soil using electrical response
description: A geophysical soil-core measurement with electrodes,not optical cloud-droplet imaging.
keywords: Track frozen soil using electrical response
reported_equipment: Temperature-controlled soil-column environment and complex-resistivity system; exact chamber model unspecified in institutional abstract

requirements.rationale: The reported soil-column environments alternate between-20 and+4 C.
The procedure must induce repeatable freeze–thaw transitions.
The sample needs electrodes and complex-resistivity instrumentation; a temperature chamber alone cannot establish the measurement.

missing_information: ESPEC is a real thermal-environment candidate; its brochure does not document the study's electrodes or impedance spectrometer.
Environmental air range is not proof of a particular soil core's equilibration time; no invented freeze front or measured conductivity is displayed.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
